event.choice.no_effect: Nothing happens. A rare moment of honesty from an event.
event.choice.skip.description: Skip the event without rewards or consequences.
event.forgotten_cache.choice.card.descri: Add a random card to your deck.
event.forgotten_cache.description: A dusty cache contains supplies. Whoever left them is no longer the point. The point is that they somehow have not killed you yet.
event.forgotten_cache.title: Forgotten cache

event.rusted_vending_altar.description: A battered machine stands here, clearly from a better age. Possibly before common sense was invented.
event.rusted_vending_altar.title: Rusted vending altar
rest.description: Choose one action. You can skip resting too.
rest.title: Rest
rest.no_upgradable_cards: There are no upgradable cards in the deck.
rest.select_upgrade_card: Choose a card to preview its upgraded version.
reward.card_choice_description: Choose 1 card out of {count}. You can cancel and return to the reward menu.
reward.card_optional: Choose one of three cards or skip this reward.
reward.gold_description: Adds this gold to your current run.
reward.no_card_options: This archetype does not receive card rewards after combat.
reward.optional_hint: Take any rewards you want, or leave without taking them.
reward.relic_description: Adds this relic to your current run.
reward.title: Rewards
run.preview.boss.description: The final fight of the act. Victory ends the current major stretch of the run.
run.preview.boss.title: Boss
run.preview.chest.description: You may gain a relic. You can skip the reward, because free will gets weird.
run.preview.chest.title: Chest
run.preview.combat.description: A fight against regular enemies. Reward: gold and, if your archetype allows it, a card choice.
run.preview.combat.title: Regular combat
run.preview.elite.description: A harder fight. Reward: more gold, a card choice, and a relic.
run.preview.elite.title: Elite combat
run.preview.event.description: An unknown room. A question mark may become a choice event or a regular combat.
run.preview.event.title: Event
run.preview.rest.description: Recover, upgrade a card, or skip the node without taking anything.
run.preview.rest.title: Rest
run.preview.shop.description: Buy cards, relics, and consumables with gold. You can also remove a card from your deck.
run.preview.shop.title: Shop
shop.remove_card_description: Choose a card to remove. Cost: {price} gold.
shop.remove_card_short_description: Removes one card from your deck. Sometimes the best upgrade is deleting junk.
shop.remove_only_first_cards: Only the first cards are shown for now. A full deck browser should be a later UI screen.
shop.title: Shop
run.map_hint.hover: Hover a room to see details.
run.map_hint.available_path: A gold line marks the next available route.
run.preview.action.completed: This room has already been completed.
run.preview.action.blocked_alternative: This branch was closed by your chosen route.
run.preview.action.future_locked: This room opens if your chosen route reaches it.
reward.chest_optional_hint: Take the relic or continue to leave it.
rest.upgrade_preview_hint: Upgrading previews the selected card copy before and after. Only this copy is upgraded, not every card with the same name.
shop.remove_scroll_hint: Showing cards {from}-{to} of {total}. Mouse wheel / Up / Down to scroll.
event.sealed_armory.title: Sealed armory
event.sealed_armory.description: Behind a heavy door, something metallic keeps sliding across the floor. The lock is rusted, but still stubborn. Wonderful, even iron has opinions now.
event.sealed_armory.choice.force.descrip: All characters lose 6 HP, but this event cannot kill them. Gain a random relic.
event.wounded_traveler.title: Wounded traveler
event.wounded_traveler.description: A traveler sits against the wall, asking for gold for medicine. Or pretending to. In this world, even pity needs paperwork.
event.wounded_traveler.choice.help.descr: Lose 25 gold and reduce all characters' stress by 10.
event.wounded_traveler.choice.rob.descri: Gain 35 gold. All characters gain 12 stress.
event.poisonous_well.title: Poisonous well
event.poisonous_well.description: The water in the well glows green. That is almost certainly bad, but it does look very resource-like.
event.poisonous_well.choice.drink.descri: All characters heal 10 HP and gain 8 stress.
event.poisonous_well.choice.collect.desc: Gain a random consumable if you have a free slot.
event.old_mapmaker.title: Old mapmaker
event.old_mapmaker.description: An old man sells a map where half the lines are crossed out and the other half were clearly drawn during an attack of optimism.
event.old_mapmaker.choice.buy.descriptio: Lose 35 gold and add a random card to your deck.
event.old_mapmaker.choice.steal.descript: Add a random card to your deck. All characters gain 15 stress.
event.quiet_bonfire.title: Quiet bonfire
event.quiet_bonfire.description: The fire is nearly dead, but you can still catch your breath beside it. A rare chance to not be punched for ten whole seconds.
event.quiet_bonfire.choice.rest.descript: All characters heal 7 HP and lose 8 stress.
event.quiet_bonfire.choice.ashes.descrip: Add a random card to your deck. All characters gain 5 stress.
event.herbalist_workbench.title: Herbalist workbench
event.herbalist_workbench.description: Knives, flasks, and tied herbs cover the table. Someone clearly tried to heal people with methods that make people question medicine.
event.herbalist_workbench.choice.brew.de: Gain a random consumable if you have a free slot.
event.herbalist_workbench.choice.study.d: Add a random card to your deck. All characters gain 6 stress.
event.whispering_mushrooms.title: Whispering mushrooms
event.whispering_mushrooms.description: The mushrooms whisper about luck, memory, and taxes. The last part is the most disturbing.
event.whispering_mushrooms.choice.eat.de: All characters lose 4 HP, but this event cannot kill them. Add a random card to your deck.
event.whispering_mushrooms.choice.harves: Gain a random consumable if you have a free slot.
event.cracked_mirror.title: Cracked mirror
event.cracked_mirror.description: The reflection moves half a second late. Unpleasant latency, but apparently acceptable FPS for magic.
event.cracked_mirror.choice.look.descrip: Gain a random relic. All characters gain 18 stress.
event.cracked_mirror.choice.break.descri: Gain 30 gold. All characters lose 5 HP, but this event cannot kill them.
floor_complete.title: Act {act} cleared
floor_complete.subtitle: Boss defeated
floor_complete.description: You survived the first act. Somehow the rust, poison, drones, and suspicious choices became a victory.
floor_complete.next_floor_placeholder: The next act is not implemented yet. Press the button below to return to the hub and start a new run.
